title: Data, Simulink models and scripts for switching-frequency-dependent leakage current in H4 and HERIC transformerless PV inverters
description: Simulink models, switching-frequency sweep data (1-40 kHz) and Python analysis scripts supporting the article Switching-frequency-dependent leakage current in H4 and HERIC transformerless PV inverters: a common-mode resonance perspective. Four cases are covered: H4 and HERIC, each with unipolar and bipolar SPWM, with a 150 nF PV-to-ground parasitic capacitance. Each sweep records RMS leakage current, efficiency and low-order THD versus switching frequency.
